metadata.library_name: Refinery Vessel Preliminary Internals Recommendation Logic
metadata.scope_note: This engine recommends candidate process internals and preliminary arrangement requirements. It does not replace process design, hydraulic sizing, mechanical design, licensor design, specialist vendor design, or code compliance verification.

automated: infer vessel service when not explicitly selected
classify fouling, solids, viscosity, slugging and separation severity
determine whether gas-liquid mist removal is required
add dependent supports, hold-downs, drains and access checks
human_confirmation: confirm flare knockout drum demister use
approve final vendor geometry and guaranteed performance

decision_distribution.principle: The user supplies process facts. The engine performs the majority of classification, selection, dependency, conflict and review logic.

condition_structure.all: All child conditions must be true.
condition_structure.any: At least one child condition must be true.
condition_structure.none: No child condition may be true.

minimum_user_inputs.label: Is a second immiscible liquid phase present?
Does a pump take suction from the vessel?

inlet_momentum_index_pa.note: Project administrator shall validate these preliminary thresholds before production use.

solids_ppm_reference.note: Used only when a numeric solids concentration is available.

variants.name: Simple inlet pipe extension or elbow
Internal drain downcomer or seal leg
Coalescer support plate or tube sheet

mandatory_actions: verify maximum allowable liquid carryover to compressor
verify drain reliability and high-high level protection
verify liquid carryover limit to burners
define clean and dirty differential pressure

restricted_recommendations.reason: Demister use requires dedicated flare-system pressure-drop, fouling, coking, fire-case and maintenance review.

general_recommendation_rules.description: Select simple inlet device for low-severity service.
Select robust impingement device for dirty, slugging or erosive service.
Select vane inlet for moderate momentum and manageable fouling.
Select cyclonic inlet candidate for high momentum and compact high-capacity service.
Recommend calming baffle where interface stability or surge control is important.
Wire mesh for clean service with normal or high separation requirement.
Vane pack for higher fouling tolerance, higher liquid loading or easier cleaning.
Cyclone mist eliminator candidate for very high capacity or very high separation severity.
Do not auto-select fine mist devices for severe fouling, coking or polymerising service.
Water or heavy-liquid boot for a small heavy-liquid fraction.
Interface weir for a significant continuous heavy-liquid flow.
Bucket-and-weir candidate for two controlled liquid outlets with significant flows.
Plate-pack coalescer for clean liquid-liquid service requiring improved separation.
Stable emulsion prevents automatic coalescer selection.
general_recommendation_rules.engineering_action: Laboratory or field testing and specialist coalescer evaluation required.

general_recommendation_rules.description: Recommend vortex breaker for pump suction or gas-entrainment-sensitive liquid outlet.
Recommend solids sump and flushing for dirty liquid service.
Recommend heating review when liquid temperature margin above pour point is low.

general_policy: A hard disqualifier always overrides a recommendation.
A service-specific restriction overrides a general recommendation.
Proprietary vendor equipment may be recommended only as a candidate, never as final selected equipment.
When two variants in the same family remain, retain both and route to targeted user confirmation.
Do not automatically choose the higher-performance or higher-cost option.
Do not automatically choose the first matching record.

family_selection_policy.FAM-INLET: Select one primary inlet-device variant, plus erosion protection if required.
family_selection_policy.FAM-GL: Select one primary gas-liquid separation variant unless a staged system is explicitly designed.
family_selection_policy.FAM-LL: One interface-control arrangement may coexist with one coalescing device.
family_selection_policy.FAM-OUTLET: One vortex breaker may be assigned to each qualifying liquid outlet.
family_selection_policy.FAM-SUPPORT: Dependent supports and drains are additive and mandatory when triggered.

additions.condition: explicit_vessel_service is provided and not contradictory
maximum gas and liquid flows are provided where applicable
densities and viscosities are provided where applicable
required separation quality is not unknown
fouling, solids, coking and polymerisation risks are defined
downstream equipment and sensitivity are defined

deductions.condition: service classifier top two scores differ by 10 points or less
a proprietary internal is the leading recommendation
severe fouling, coking or polymerisation exists
required separation quality is very high but performance target is missing

targeted_user_confirmation_rules.trigger: service classifier top two scores differ by 10 points or less
targeted_user_confirmation_rules.question: Which vessel service is intended?

targeted_user_confirmation_rules.trigger: INL-004 is the leading inlet recommendation
targeted_user_confirmation_rules.question: Use a proprietary cyclonic inlet candidate?

targeted_user_confirmation_rules.trigger: GL-003 or GL-004 is the leading gas-liquid recommendation
targeted_user_confirmation_rules.question: Proceed to specialist vendor selection?

targeted_user_confirmation_rules.trigger: boot and weir are both valid candidates
targeted_user_confirmation_rules.question: Prefer boot or internal weir arrangement?

targeted_user_confirmation_rules.trigger: explicit_vessel_service equals flare_knockout_drum and a demister is being considered
targeted_user_confirmation_rules.question: Has flare-system demister review been completed?

engine_pseudocode: 1. Validate minimum inputs. Stop on blocking inconsistency.
2. Calculate derived fields including phase_system, inlet_momentum_category, fouling_risk, viscosity_category and heating_review_required.
5. Select highest-scoring service only when score separation exceeds the ambiguity threshold.
7. Apply general recommendation rules in priority order.
9. Add dependent supports, hold-downs, drains and access checks.
10. Resolve family conflicts without choosing the first or highest-performance option automatically.
12. Route only unresolved or proprietary decisions to targeted user confirmation.
13. Return preliminary recommendations, excluded options, missing inputs, warnings and engineering actions.

recommended_internals: INL-001 or INL-003 depending on resolved inlet momentum
OUT-001 for each pumped liquid outlet
targeted_user_confirmations: Confirm final inlet-device variant if inlet momentum remains unknown.
engineering_actions: Verify boot volume, interface control range and drain reliability.
Vendor-confirm mist eliminator sizing and pressure drop.
Mechanically design support grids, hold-downs and drains.

production_readiness_checks: Project administrator has approved all configurable thresholds.
Input units are validated and converted to a single internal unit system.
Rule priority and conflict handling are unit-tested.
Every recommendation displays the triggering rule IDs.
Every proprietary item is marked vendor-design-required.
No recommendation is treated as final hydraulic or mechanical design.
Change history, library version and checksum are stored with every result.
Regression tests cover all ten MVP vessel services.
Engineering department has reviewed recommendation wording and warning text.
